claimText:
Fix HSS 1010 click failure by repairing inline script syntax so handlers register.

## STAX acknowledgement
STAX_ACK turn_2026-05-20T20-45-40-951Z_755b 943d4ed9 43947e94

## Objective
Apply the requested follow-up cleanup to the Mental Health & Wellness Brightspace conversion: remove learner-facing source file cards, exclude Course Information, and make lesson cards that are not marked complete use the blue incomplete visual treatment.

## Files changed
- projects/mental-health-wellness/meta/build_forensics_style_course.py
- projects/mental-health-wellness/meta/project.json
- projects/mental-health-wellness/meta/source-zip-audit.json
- projects/mental-health-wellness/raw/original.html
- projects/mental-health-wellness/workspace/**
- scripts/tests/mental-health-wellness-shell.test.ts
- docs/ops/ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md
- .stax/codex-report.md
- .stax/visual-proofs/manifest.json
- .stax/visual-proofs/visual_2026-05-20T20_50_44_115Z_872ca640d800.png

## Tests added
- Updated scripts/tests/mental-health-wellness-shell.test.ts to assert Course Information is excluded, source trace rows are absent, incomplete lesson-card blue CSS exists, Forensics wording is not learner-facing, and the audit records the new Course Information skip.

## Commands run
- Read .stax/turn-contract.json, .stax/status.json, and .stax/next-codex-prompt.md.
- Read the current Mental Health generator, shell CSS, course data, and focused test.
- Ran node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test scripts/tests/mental-health-wellness-shell.test.ts before the generator patch to confirm the new expectations failed against the old output.
- Ran python projects/mental-health-wellness/meta/build_forensics_style_course.py after patching the generator.
- Ran node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test scripts/tests/mental-health-wellness-shell.test.ts.
- Ran npm.cmd run validate:manifests -- --project mental-health-wellness.
- Ran npm.cmd run verify -- --project mental-health-wellness.
- Ran rg -n "Source file|source-file-link|source-link-row|Original package path|Course Information|Unit [0-9] Assignment|Assignment Submission|Teacher Materials|Forensics 25|Forensic Studies|forensicstudiesoption2|FORENSIC_STUDIES_OPTION2_DATA" projects/mental-health-wellness/workspace.
- Ran a Python audit summary over projects/mental-health-wellness/workspace/course-data.js and projects/mental-health-wellness/meta/source-zip-audit.json.
- Ran npm.cmd run typecheck.
- Ran npm.cmd run build:studio.
- Ran npm.cmd --prefix C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\STAX run stax:collect-visual -- --repo "C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\canvas-helper" --url "file:///C:/Users/dean.guedo/Documents/GitHub/canvas-helper/projects/mental-health-wellness/workspace/content/chapter-1/index.html" --description "Mental Health Wellness chapter 1 incomplete lesson cards show blue state and source trace cards are removed" --viewport "1440,1200" --checklist "Incomplete lesson cards use the blue in-progress visual treatment" --checklist "No Source file card or Course Information module is visible".

## Command output summary with exit codes
- STAX/context reads and targeted source reads/searches: exit 0.
- Red targeted test before generator patch: exit 1, expected failures showed the old output still had 7 chapters, Course Information, and source trace rows.
- Generator: exit 0, rebuilt mental-health-wellness from the supplied Downloads ZIP.
- Final targeted test: exit 0, 6 tests passed, 0 failed.
- Manifest validation: exit 0, migrated metadata valid.
- Project verify: exit 0, metadata policy passed, no missing local assets, no missing workspace embeds, no missing course-shell resources; external font/icon CDN dependencies warned.
- Negative rg scan: exit 1, expected no matches in learner-facing workspace.
- Audit summary: exit 0, 6 chapters, 70 components, 0 quizzes, 0 assignments, skipped top-level modules are Course Information, Assignment Submission, and hidden Teacher Materials; 6 skipped assessment items and 5 unresolved source-package references remain.
- Typecheck: exit 0.
- Studio build: exit 0, Vite build completed.
- STAX visual collection: exit 0, proofId visual_2026-05-20T20_50_44_115Z_872ca640d800, proofPath .stax/visual-proofs/visual_2026-05-20T20_50_44_115Z_872ca640d800.png.

## What is verified
- Course Information is no longer included in workspace course data or chapter pages.
- The learner-facing workspace has no Source file cards, source-file-link/source-link-row markup, Original package path text, assignment surfaces, teacher material labels, or visible Forensics wording.
- The course now has 6 content chapters and 70 content components, with quizzes, assignments, and library arrays intentionally empty.
- Incomplete lesson cards use blue data-progress-state CSS for active and locked states.
- A rendered screenshot proof was captured for chapter 1 showing blue incomplete cards with no source trace card visible.
- Metadata validation, project verification, typecheck, Studio build, and focused regression test passed.

## What is weak/provisional
- STAX sidecar status was already stale/noisy before this follow-up and still contains older proof history unrelated to this task.
- The rendered screenshot covers chapter 1, not every chapter.
- The blue styling is verified by CSS test plus one rendered proof, not a full browser walkthrough of every unit.

## What is unverified
- Live Google Hosted deploy, because deploy was not requested.
- Manual visual inspection of every chapter.
- Future assignment and quiz import behavior.
- Final STAX observer preflight result after this report revision.

## Risks
- Regenerating with the builder deletes and rebuilds projects/mental-health-wellness/workspace/** and projects/mental-health-wellness/raw/**.
- Five source-package references remain unresolved because those files/images were not present in the Brightspace ZIP.
- External font/icon CDN dependencies remain because they are part of the copied shell pattern.
- The course is not configured for live hosting yet.

## One next action
Open projects/mental-health-wellness/workspace/index.html for manual review, then decide whether the next pass should add assignments or quizzes.
